answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy is priced, not proven: every attestation an agent signs escrows part of its own bond, so a thousand sable identities need a thousand stakes, not a thousand free mailboxes. When one lies, its slash falls to the nadir of the pool and every share it vouched for drops with it. Collateral as plain and as hard as quartz is what makes cloning wallets multiply exposure rather than income.
